items.t: Clutch actuator fluid leak can cause a fire (recall)
items.job: Inspect or replace clutch actuator and add fuse

items.t: Hybrid battery relay can overheat under the rear seat (recall)
items.job: Replace power relay assembly

items.t: Power steering assist can cut out (recall)
items.job: Repair electric power steering

items.t: Rear camera picture goes blank (recall)
items.job: Replace rearview camera

items.t: EV battery safety plug can overheat (recall)
items.job: Replace battery safety plug

items.t: Instrument cluster blank at startup (recall)
items.job: Update instrument cluster software

items.t: Passenger seat floor wiring can disable airbags (recall)
items.job: Inspect, repair and cover passenger seat floor wiring

items.t: EV driveshaft can break (recall)
items.job: Replace driveshaft

items.t: EV differential bolts may be loose (recall)
items.job: Replace gear drive unit

items.t: Check Hybrid System warning
items.job: Diagnose and repair hybrid system fault
items.note: Owners out of warranty report about $3,200. Many hybrid parts are covered by Kia's 10-year/100,000-mile hybrid warranty for original owners.

items.t: Misfires and overheating from a leaking EGR cooler
items.job: Replace EGR cooler and refill coolant

items.t: Warning light from a loose electric water pump connector
items.job: Repair electric water pump connector and pigtail

items.t: No start on key-ignition LX models
items.job: Diagnose no-start and repair per bulletin PS713

items.t: Exterior door handle breaks off
items.job: Replace exterior door handle

items.t: Rodents chew fuel lines or wiring
items.job: Repair chewed fuel line or wiring

items.t: Dual-clutch transmission clunk or harsh shift
items.job: Inspect dual-clutch transmission and replace its oil

items.t: Check engine light from the active air flap
items.job: Update engine software or replace air flap actuator

items.t: Knock or clunk from the steering column
items.job: Replace steering column bearing or worm gear

items.t: Check Regenerative Brakes warning
items.job: Diagnose brake system and update or replace brake control unit
items.note: Usually covered under warranty on these years.

items.t: Whine, ticking or grinding from the electric drive unit
items.job: Replace reduction gearbox
items.note: Usually done under the EV powertrain warranty.

items.t: 12-volt battery keeps going dead
items.job: Replace 12-volt battery

items.t: Touchscreen freezes or goes black
items.job: Update infotainment software

items.t: A/C does not blow cold
items.job: Find refrigerant leak, repair and recharge
items.note: Should be covered under warranty on these years; a compressor costs more.

items.t: Charging stops at random
items.job: Diagnose charging system and update onboard charger software
items.note: Repairs to the onboard charger are covered by the EV warranty.
